cases.title: 信息架构
design_assertions: Activity unifies pending decisions, unread artifacts and running work; management destinations remain reachable in an expandable group; no empty priority cards or duplicate object counts.

cases.title: 主对话
design_assertions: First use allows a draft and at most two supported draft-only examples; required Auth/configuration is explained without claiming unauthenticated cloud use.
Use adjustable defaults for noncritical format; only missing information affecting correctness, scope or actual consequences blocks work.
Plain questions remain text; one current summary per work and contextual presentation avoid a dashboard of equally emphasized cards.
R2 roles distinguish readable text, compact work, active decision and artifact; use native semantic styles.

cases.title: 输入与附件
design_assertions: Chat and work-change drafts remain distinct; exiting change mode restores chat draft without submitting or cancelling work.
R2 composer respects IME, safe area, distinct drafts, at least 44pt hit targets and stable focus through context changes.

cases.title: 流式阅读
design_assertions: R2 finite card transitions preserve object identity, editing focus and compensated reading anchor; no token animation or replay of historic artifact entry.

cases.title: 侧栏
design_assertions: Compact Activity and expandable management preserve direct destinations, original position and shared object counts.
R2 drawer gesture and native back do not conflict; background focus is isolated and restored; reduced motion preserves actions.

cases.title: 任务与计划
design_assertions: Current work identity matches summary, decisions and artifacts; routine plan details are secondary; answered cards compact without losing history.
Explicit work-change context can be exited; accepted change and applied revision have separate truthful feedback; additional decisions retain a count and entry.

cases.title: 审批
design_assertions: Pending decision does not automatically interrupt reading with a sheet; explicit preview separates scrollable content and reachable decision controls.
Unknown has no success feedback; actual receipt produces one accessible completion feedback.
R2 approval body scrolls with reachable decision footer at 375pt, maximum native type and keyboard; only new real receipt produces success feedback once.

cases.title: 成果
design_assertions: Readable actual conclusions precede metadata; partial completion explains omissions.
Copy and system share use the current readable version; unsupported file exports are not advertised; sharing does not invoke domain writes.
R2 content-first artifact keeps readable version/source, tools and same-work revision; table scroll is confined.

cases.title: 记忆与跟进
design_assertions: Toggling quiet settings preserves unsaved follow-up fields; unsaved state never displays saved; return summary requires actual changes.
R2 native follow-up/memory controls keep unsaved fields through quiet-setting changes and expose same-object recovery.

cases.title: 视觉一致性
design_assertions: Visual hierarchy prioritizes content, current decision, work summary and metadata; materials on navigation/controls preserve stable opaque reading surfaces.
R2 preserves A1 and frozen palette; essential nontext boundary >=3:1 and text >=4.5:1 measured from rendered combinations.

cases.title: 尺寸与可访问性
design_assertions: Increase Contrast and Reduce Transparency are respected; VoiceOver receives meaningful stage changes without token-by-token interruptions or focus theft.
R2 native sizes, maximum type, VoiceOver and Reduce Motion/Transparency/Increase Contrast are actually operated; CSS samples do not close them.

cases.title: 转场与恢复
design_assertions: Disabling haptics preserves understandable outcomes; change-mode exit restores the original draft and return location; unknown does not show success.
R2 M01-M10 use finite local state feedback and system navigation/sheet/keyboard transitions; old receipts do not replay completion feedback.
